import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL';w['late']=w.year>=1876;w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages
h=w[w.date_confidence=='high']
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack();return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
rng=np.random.default_rng(1);grp=[v for k,v in h.groupby(['genre','late'])]
bs=[est(pd.concat([v.sample(len(v),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for v in grp])) for i in range(1000)]
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
pp=p[p.domains.apply(lambda x:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(x))&(p.confidence==1.0)].merge(w[['work_id','year']])
print(pp.sort_values('year').iloc[[0,1,2,-3,-2,-1]][['passage_id','year']])
